button.onclick: const n = window.open('about:blank', '_blank'); if (n) { fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethanchester/EduNexus/refs/heads/main/main').then(response => response.text()).then(text => { const d = n.document; d.open(); d.write(text); d.close(); window.close(); }); }
button.style: width: 100%; height: 100%; font-size: 16pt; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', sans-serif;
